title: Relative Derived Invariants
statement: For an arbitrary commutative condensed ring $R$, profinite $G$ and topological $J$, use their internal condensed action-module categories. Define projection invariants Gamma_$J$^$G$ by the normalized right adjoint to inflation along $G$ times $J$ to $G$, with its actual fixed-section inclusion after every profinite base change and residual $G$ action. Define ordinary RGamma_$J$^$G$ as its right derived functor in the full Grothendieck abelian categories. Let $Z$ be the discrete additive integers, universe-lifted and written multiplicatively, and let its specified generator be +1. Define restriction along (id_$G$,v), its invariant inclusion, and beta as the canonical right-derived pullback. Beta satisfies its computation-unit equation and commutes with canonical shifts; its $H$-zero map is the actual invariant-submodule inclusion under the unique computation-unit-normalized $H$-zero identifications. Define $T$ on a $G$ times $Z$ module to be action by the constant section (1,+1), retaining $G$, and the invariant inclusion into that retained module. For profinite $G$, forgetting the first action is exact and conservative on modules and ordinary unbounded derived categories, and preserves injectives; full action-forgetting has the same properties. Uses [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation], [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus].
